name: Prokhorovka - Hill 252.2 Sector
historical_basis: Prokhorovka, 12 July 1943: Hill 252.2, Oktyabrskiy State Farm, the Psel corridor, anti-tank ditch, and railway embankment.
design_notes: open steppe tank map: a central east-west railway embankment divides the sectors, an open Psel flank in the west, and contested hill high ground in the east
1000m x 1000m at 5m height samples; the map is mirror-symmetric across the central embankment axis so both teams get equivalent ground
